title: Tutorial: Crystal and Band structure
body:
Updated the previous "crystal_and_band_structure" to the new sphinx-gallery format (Issue #1768).

For this, I split the previous tutorial into two separate tutorials:
- ```bulk.py```: Creating bulk structures, running EoS and bulk relaxation calculations
- ```band_structure.py```: Use GPAW as a calculator to calculate the band structure of a Ag bulk crystal
I also updated the .gitignore to ignore *.cube files, as these can become quite large, however this is not necessary.
